csv_agency: County of Orange Public Works / Procurement
csv_scope_of_work: OC Public Works, on behalf of the County of Orange (County) and Orange County Flood Control District (District), requires supplemental professional services to meet workload demands and project scheduling commitments in relation to Architect-Engineer (A-E) Design, Project Administration and Management Services for various projects. A-E is defined as an Architect or Engineer for design and/or engineering of a project. To supplement existing resources, County intends to issue Architect-Engineer (A-E) Cost Estimating Design Support Services Task Order Contracts for use by County and District on an "as-needed" basis. No specified amount of work is guaranteed to Respondent
